/* selectSchdlRsvtList - kim.seong.ok */ A.* FROM ( SELECT A.RESRCE_CL_MNG_ESNTAL_NO /* 자원분류관리고유번호 */ , A.RSVT_SN /* 예약일렬번호(색인일련번호) */ , A.INST_NO /* 기관번호 */ , A.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD /* 단위업무구분코드 */ , A.USER_ID /* 사용자 아이디 */ , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.RSVT_BGNG_YMD), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS RSVT_BGNG_YMD /* 예약시작일 */ , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.RSVT_BGNG_YMD, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'dy') AS DAY_OF_WEEK /* 예약시작일 요일 */ , A.USE_PURPS_SE_CD /* 사용목적구분코드 */ , A.RESRCE_NM /* 자원명 */ , (SELECT PIC_ID FROM SBD330 WHERE RESRCE_CL_MNG_ESNTAL_NO = A.RESRCE_CL_MNG_ESNTAL_NO AND RSVT_SN = A.RSVT_SN AND PCHPRS_YN = 'Y') AS PCHPRS_Y_PIC_ID /* 담당자 아이디 */ , (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM SBD330 WHERE RESRCE_CL_MNG_ESNTAL_NO = A.RESRCE_CL_MNG_ESNTAL_NO AND RSVT_SN = A.RSVT_SN AND PCHPRS_YN = 'N') AS PCHPRS_N_PIC_ID_CNT /* 담당자 수 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(C##RG.SA_FN_GET_NAME( (SELECT PIC_ID FROM SBD330 WHERE RESRCE_CL_MNG_ESNTAL_NO = A.RESRCE_CL_MNG_ESNTAL_NO AND RSVT_SN = A.RSVT_SN AND PCHPRS_YN = 'Y') )) AS PCHPRS_Y_PIC_NM /* 담당자 */ , B.TRPR_INFO_NO /* 대상자정보번호 */ , B.CASE_MNG_NO /* 사례관리번호 */ , B.CASE_MNG_ODRNO /* 사례관리차수 */ , C.TRPR_NM_ENCPT /* 대상자명 암호화 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(C.TRPR_NM_ENCPT) AS TRPR_NM /* 대상자명 */ , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(C.TRPR_BRTH_YMD), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS TRPR_BRTH_YMD /* 대상자출생일자 */ , C.SXDC_SE_CD /* 대상자성별 */ , A.RSVT_STTS_SE_CD /* 예약상태구분코드 */ , A.RSVT_CHRCTR_SNDNG_YN /* 예약문자발송여부 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(C##RG.SA_FN_GET_NAME(A.USER_ID)) AS USER_NM /* 등록자 */ , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.RSVT_APLY_YMD), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS RSVT_APLY_YMD /* 예약신청일(등록 or 수정) */ , E.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD /* 졸업상태 */ , F.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS ACBG_SE_CD /* 학력 */ , G.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS GRADE_SE_CD /* 학년 */ FROM SBD310 A LEFT JOIN SBD320 B ON A.RESRCE_CL_MNG_ESNTAL_NO = B.RESRCE_CL_MNG_ESNTAL_NO AND A.RSVT_SN = B.RSVT_SN LEFT JOIN SEA200 C ON B.TRPR_INFO_NO = C.TRPR_INFO_NO LEFT JOIN (SELECT A.* , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.TRPR_INFO_NO ORDER BY B.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1 DESC, A.MNG_SN DESC) AS RN FROM SEA230 A LEFT JOIN SAC100 B ON B.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'ACBG_SE_CD' AND B.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = A.ACBG_SE_CD WHERE A.DEL_YN != 'Y' ) D /*학력관리 테이블*/ ON D.RN = 1 AND C.TRPR_INFO_NO = D.TRPR_INFO_NO --대상자정보번호 LEFT JOIN SAC100 E ON E.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD' AND E.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = D.GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD LEFT JOIN SAC100 F ON F.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'ACBG_SE_CD' AND F.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = D.ACBG_SE_CD LEFT JOIN SAC100 G ON G.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'GRADE_SE_CD' AND G.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = D.GRADE_SE_CD
,(SELECT C##RG.SA_FN_GET_NAME( T.PIC_ID ) AS PCHPRS_Y_PIC_NM , T.RESRCE_CL_MNG_ESNTAL_NO , T.RSVT_SN FROM ( SELECT PIC_ID, RESRCE_CL_MNG_ESNTAL_NO, RSVT_SN FROM SBD330 WHERE PCHPRS_YN = 'Y' ) T ) D /* 담당자명 가져오는 가상테이블 */
,(SELECT C##RG.SA_FN_GET_NAME( T.USER_ID ) AS REG_NM FROM ( SELECT USER_ID FROM SBD310 GROUP BY USER_ID ) T ) E /* 등록자 가져오는 가상테이블 */
WHERE 1=1 AND A.INST_NO = #{INST_NO} AND A.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} AND A.RSVT_SE_CD = '02'

AND RSVT_STTS_SE_CD = #{SEARCH_RSVT_STTS_SE_CD}
) A ORDER BY A.RSVT_BGNG_YMD DESC

/* selectSchdlRsvtTrprDtlList - kim.seong.ok */ SELECT * FROM ( SELECT A.RESRCE_CL_MNG_ESNTAL_NO /* 자원분류관리고유번호 */ , A.RSVT_SN /* 예약일렬번호(색인일련번호) */ , A.INDEX_SN /* 색인일렬번호 */ , A.CASE_MNG_NO , A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO , B.TRPR_INFO_NO /* 대상자정보번호 */ , B.RCPT_INST_NO , C##RG.DEC_B64(B.TRPR_NM_ENCPT) AS TRPR_NM /* 대상자명 암호화 */ , B.TRPR_BRTH_YMD /* 대상자출생일자 */ , B.SXDC_SE_CD /* 대상자성별 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(B.EML_ADDR_ENCPT) AS EML_ADDR /* 이메일암호화 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(B.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT) AS MBL_TELNO /* 이메일암호화 */ , B.SNS_SE_CD /* SNS구분코드 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(B.MSNGR_ID_ENCPT) AS MSNGR_ID /* 메신저아이디암호화 */ , E.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD /* 졸업상태 */ , F.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS ACBG_SE_CD /* 학력 */ , G.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS GRADE_SE_CD /* 학년 */ FROM SBD320 A LEFT JOIN SEA200 B ON A.TRPR_INFO_NO = B.TRPR_INFO_NO LEFT JOIN (SELECT A.* , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.TRPR_INFO_NO ORDER BY B.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1 DESC, A.MNG_SN DESC) AS RN FROM SEA230 A LEFT JOIN SAC100 B ON B.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'ACBG_SE_CD' AND B.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = A.ACBG_SE_CD WHERE A.DEL_YN != 'Y' ) D /*학력관리 테이블*/ ON D.RN = 1 AND B.TRPR_INFO_NO = D.TRPR_INFO_NO --대상자정보번호 LEFT JOIN SAC100 E ON E.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD' AND E.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = D.GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD LEFT JOIN SAC100 F ON F.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'ACBG_SE_CD' AND F.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = D.ACBG_SE_CD LEFT JOIN SAC100 G ON G.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'GRADE_SE_CD' AND G.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = D.GRADE_SE_CD WHERE 1=1 AND A.RESRCE_CL_MNG_ESNTAL_NO = #{RESRCE_CL_MNG_ESNTAL_NO} AND A.RSVT_SN = #{RSVT_SN} AND B.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} )

/* selectSchdlRsvtDtl - kim.seong.ok */
SELECT RESRCE_CL_MNG_ESNTAL_NO /* 자원분류관리고유번호 */ , RSVT_SN /* 예약일렬번호(색인일련번호) */ , INST_NO /* 기관번호 */ , UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD /* 단위업무구분코드 */ , USER_ID /* 사용자 아이디 */ , RESRCE_CL_MNG_LCLAS_SE_CD /* 자원분류관리대분류구분코드 */ , RSVT_SE_CD /* 예약구분코드 */ , RESRCE_NM /* 자원명 */ , RSVT_BGNG_YMD /* 예약시작일 */ , RSVT_END_YMD /* 예약종료일 */ , RSVT_BGNG_HR /* 예약시작시간 */ , RSVT_END_HR /* 예약종료시간 */ , RSVT_APLY_ENFSN_NO /* 예약신청자(로그인사용자종사자번호) */ , USE_PURPS_SE_CD /* 사용목적구분코드 */ , USE_PURPS_CN /* 사용목적내용 */ , RM_CN /* 비고내용 */ , RSVT_APLY_YMD /* 예약신청일(등록 or 수정) */ , RSVT_STTS_SE_CD /* 예약상태구분코드 */ , RSVT_CHRCTR_SNDNG_YMD /* 예약문자발송일 */ , RSVT_CHRCTR_SNDNG_HR /* 예약문자발송시간 */ , RSVT_CHRCTR_SNDNG_CN /* 예약문자발송내용 */ , RSVT_CHRCTR_SNDNG_YN /* 예약문자발송여부 */ , FRST_RGTR_ID /* 최초등록자아이디 */ , FRST_REG_DT /* 최초등록일시 */ , LAST_MDFR_ID /* 최종수정자아이디 */ , LAST_MDFCN_DT /* 최종수정일시 */ FROM SBD310 WHERE 1=1 AND INST_NO = #{INST_NO} AND UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} AND RESRCE_CL_MNG_ESNTAL_NO = #{RESRCE_CL_MNG_ESNTAL_NO} AND RSVT_SN = #{RSVT_SN}

/* selectDailyList - kim.seong.ok */ SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY C.TRPR_INFO_NO ORDER BY F.SRTNG_SQNCE DESC, E.SRTNG_SQNCE DESC) ROW_NO , A.RESRCE_CL_MNG_ESNTAL_NO /* 자원분류관리고유번호 */ , A.RSVT_SN /* 예약일렬번호(색인일련번호) */ , A.INST_NO /* 기관번호 */ , A.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD /* 단위업무구분코드 */ , A.USER_ID /* 사용자 아이디 */ , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.RSVT_BGNG_YMD), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS RSVT_BGNG_YMD /* 예약시작일 */ , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.RSVT_APLY_YMD, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'dy') AS DAY_OF_WEEK /* 요일 */ , A.RSVT_BGNG_HR /* 예약시작시간 */ , A.RSVT_END_HR /* 예약종료시간 */ , A.USE_PURPS_SE_CD /* 사용목적구분코드 */ , A.RESRCE_NM /* 자원명 */ , (SELECT PIC_ID FROM SBD330 WHERE RESRCE_CL_MNG_ESNTAL_NO = A.RESRCE_CL_MNG_ESNTAL_NO AND RSVT_SN = A.RSVT_SN AND PCHPRS_YN = 'Y') AS PCHPRS_Y_PIC_ID /* 담당자 아이디 */ , (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM SBD330 WHERE RESRCE_CL_MNG_ESNTAL_NO = A.RESRCE_CL_MNG_ESNTAL_NO AND RSVT_SN = A.RSVT_SN AND PCHPRS_YN = 'N') AS PCHPRS_N_PIC_ID_CNT /* 담당자 수 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(C##RG.SA_FN_GET_NAME( (SELECT PIC_ID FROM SBD330 WHERE RESRCE_CL_MNG_ESNTAL_NO = A.RESRCE_CL_MNG_ESNTAL_NO AND RSVT_SN = A.RSVT_SN AND PCHPRS_YN = 'Y') )) AS PCHPRS_Y_PIC_NM /* 담당자 */ , B.TRPR_INFO_NO /* 대상자정보번호 */ , B.CASE_MNG_NO /* 사례관리번호 */ , B.CASE_MNG_ODRNO /* 사례관리차수 */ , C.TRPR_NM_ENCPT /* 대상자명 암호화 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(C.TRPR_NM_ENCPT) AS TRPR_NM /* 대상자명 */ , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(C.TRPR_BRTH_YMD), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS TRPR_BRTH_YMD /* 대상자출생일자 */ , C.SXDC_SE_CD /* 대상자성별 */ , A.RSVT_STTS_SE_CD /* 예약상태구분코드 */ , A.RSVT_CHRCTR_SNDNG_YN /* 예약문자발송여부 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(C##RG.SA_FN_GET_NAME(A.USER_ID)) AS USER_NM /* 등록자 */ , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.RSVT_APLY_YMD), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS RSVT_APLY_YMD /* 예약신청일(등록 or 수정) */ , E.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD /* 졸업상태 */ , F.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS ACBG_SE_CD /* 학력 */ , G.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS GRADE_SE_CD /* 학년 */ FROM SBD310 A LEFT JOIN SBD320 B ON A.RESRCE_CL_MNG_ESNTAL_NO = B.RESRCE_CL_MNG_ESNTAL_NO AND A.RSVT_SN = B.RSVT_SN LEFT JOIN SEA200 C ON B.TRPR_INFO_NO = C.TRPR_INFO_NO LEFT JOIN SEA230 D ON C.TRPR_INFO_NO = D.TRPR_INFO_NO LEFT JOIN SAC100 E ON E.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD' AND E.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = D.GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD LEFT JOIN SAC100 F ON F.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'ACBG_SE_CD' AND F.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = D.ACBG_SE_CD LEFT JOIN SAC100 G ON G.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'GRADE_SE_CD' AND G.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = D.GRADE_SE_CD
WHERE 1=1 AND A.INST_NO = #{INST_NO} AND A.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} AND A.RSVT_SE_CD = '02' AND A.RSVT_STTS_SE_CD = '01' AND A.RSVT_BGNG_YMD = #{SEARCH_DATE} AND A.RSVT_SN = #{RSVT_SN} AND A.RESRCE_CL_MNG_ESNTAL_NO = #{RESRCE_CL_MNG_ESNTAL_NO} ORDER BY A.RSVT_SN DESC ) WHERE ROW_NO = 1

SELECT DISTINCT A.RESRCE_CL_MNG_ESNTAL_NO /* 자원분류관리고유번호 */ , A.RSVT_SN /* 예약일렬번호(색인일련번호) */ , A.INST_NO /* 기관번호 */ , A.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD /* 단위업무구분코드 */ , A.USER_ID /* 사용자 아이디 */ , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.RSVT_BGNG_YMD), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS RSVT_BGNG_YMD /* 예약시작일 */ , A.RSVT_BGNG_HR /* 예약시작시간 */ , A.RSVT_END_HR /* 예약종료시간 */ , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.RSVT_BGNG_YMD, 'YYYYMMDD'), 'dy') AS DAY_OF_WEEK /* 예약시작일 요일 */ , A.USE_PURPS_SE_CD /* 사용목적구분코드 */ , A.RESRCE_NM /* 자원명 */ , (SELECT PIC_ID FROM SBD330 WHERE RESRCE_CL_MNG_ESNTAL_NO = A.RESRCE_CL_MNG_ESNTAL_NO AND RSVT_SN = A.RSVT_SN AND PCHPRS_YN = 'Y') AS PCHPRS_Y_PIC_ID /* 담당자 아이디 */ , (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM SBD330 WHERE RESRCE_CL_MNG_ESNTAL_NO = A.RESRCE_CL_MNG_ESNTAL_NO AND RSVT_SN = A.RSVT_SN AND PCHPRS_YN = 'N') AS PCHPRS_N_PIC_ID_CNT /* 담당자 수 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(C##RG.SA_FN_GET_NAME( (SELECT PIC_ID FROM SBD330 WHERE RESRCE_CL_MNG_ESNTAL_NO = A.RESRCE_CL_MNG_ESNTAL_NO AND RSVT_SN = A.RSVT_SN AND PCHPRS_YN = 'Y') )) AS PCHPRS_Y_PIC_NM /* 담당자 */ , A.RSVT_STTS_SE_CD /* 예약상태구분코드 */ , A.RSVT_CHRCTR_SNDNG_YN /* 예약문자발송여부 */ , C##RG.DEC_B64(C##RG.SA_FN_GET_NAME(A.USER_ID)) AS USER_NM /* 등록자 */ , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(A.RSVT_APLY_YMD), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS RSVT_APLY_YMD /* 예약신청일(등록 or 수정) */ FROM SBD310 A ,SBD320 B ,SEA200 C WHERE 1=1 AND A.INST_NO = #{INST_NO} AND A.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} AND A.RSVT_SE_CD = '02' AND A.RSVT_STTS_SE_CD = '01' AND A.RSVT_BGNG_YMD = #{SEARCH_DATE} AND A.RESRCE_CL_MNG_ESNTAL_NO = B.RESRCE_CL_MNG_ESNTAL_NO AND A.RSVT_SN = B.RSVT_SN AND B.TRPR_INFO_NO = C.TRPR_INFO_NO
ORDER BY RSVT_BGNG_HR, RSVT_END_HR, RSVT_SN DESC

/* selectedMonthsRsvtCnt - kim.seong.ok */
SELECT C.RSVT_DATE , COUNT(C.RSVT_DATE) AS CNT FROM SBD300 A JOIN SBD310 B ON A.INST_NO = B.INST_NO AND A.RESRCE_CL_MNG_ESNTAL_NO = B.RESRCE_CL_MNG_ESNTAL_NO AND A.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = B.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD JOIN ( SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{SEARCH_MONTHS}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')+LEVEL-1, 'YYYYMMDD') AS RSVT_DATE FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= (SELECT LAST_DAY(TO_DATE(#{SEARCH_MONTHS}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')) - TO_DATE(#{SEARCH_MONTHS}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 FROM DUAL) ) C ON C.RSVT_DATE BETWEEN B.RSVT_BGNG_YMD AND B.RSVT_END_YMD WHERE 1=1 AND A.INST_NO = #{INST_NO} AND A.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} AND B.RSVT_STTS_SE_CD = '01' GROUP BY C.RSVT_DATE
